## Mapping Decisions

- Nine PERSON records have three distinct employer strings; all three are also represented
  among organization-name records. Model those values as deduplicated embedded ORGANIZATION
  masters rather than as standalone person features.
- Preserve the source relationship domain and keys. Of 18 relationship keys, 15 match IDs
  in this source and three collide with POLICYHOLDERS IDs. Do not infer cross-source links
  from an ID collision.
- Keep generic root `DATE` as payload because its specific meaning is not established.
- Preserve source `RECORD_TYPE` values despite seven analyzer name-plausibility flags on
  source-labeled organizations; the advisory flags alone do not establish incorrect types.
- The original source is unchanged. The improved copy normalizes one display-name/address
  wrapper in `EMAIL_ADDRESS` to the enclosed address, which is independently present as a
  source value.

## Reproducibility

From the repository root:

```sh
javac -Xlint:all -d /tmp/vendor-registry-transform-build \
  src/transform/JsonSupport.java src/transform/transform_VENDOR_REGISTRY.java
java -cp /tmp/vendor-registry-transform-build TransformVendorRegistry \
  data/raw/VENDOR_REGISTRY-improved.jsonl -o data/senzing-ready/VENDOR_REGISTRY.jsonl
```

The complete field map and discriminator configuration are archived at
`docs/mapping/VENDOR_REGISTRY_mapping_spec.json`.
